data.name: Haritha
data.gender_notes: Haritha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A beautiful and delicate name, symbolizing growth and beauty. The name Haritha carries the meaning “Blooming Flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haritha usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Haritha is derived from the Arabic word 'harith', which means 'to bloom' or 'to flourish'.
data.etymology: Haritha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blooming Flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haritha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: حريثة
in_arabic.meaning: حريثة يعني الشخص الذي يحرث الأرض أو يزرعها
in_arabic.long_meaning: حريثة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ح ر ث' والذي يعني الحرث أو الزراعة. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم بالشخص الذي يحرث الأرض أو يزرعها، مما يعبر عن العمل الجاد والاهتمام بالزراعة والطبيعة. كما يمكن أن يرتبط بالخصوبة والإنتاجية. في بعض الأحيان، يُستخدم الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يبذر الخير وينشر الفلاح.

in_urdu.name: حریثہ
in_urdu.meaning: حریثہ کا مطلب ہے زمین کا مالک یا کاشتکار
in_urdu.long_meaning: حریثہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ح ر ث' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حراثت یا زراعت۔ اردو میں، یہ نام زمین کے مالک یا کاشتکار کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام محنت، لگن اور زمین کے ساتھ تعلق کی علامت ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو محنت اور لگن کے ساتھ زندگی گزارتے ہیں اور اپنے کام میں مثالی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: हरिथा
in_hindi.meaning: हरिथा का अर्थ है ज़मीन का मालिक या किसान
in_hindi.long_meaning: हरिथा एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ح ر ث' के मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जुताई या कृषि। हिंदी में, यह नाम ज़मीन के मालिक या किसान के रूप में समझा जाता है। यह नाम कड़ी मेहनत, समर्पण और ज़मीन से जुड़ाव का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो अपने काम में मेहनती और समर्पित होते हैं।

in_pashto.name: حریثه
in_pashto.meaning: حریثه د ځمکې خاوند یا بزګر معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حریثه د عربي نوم دی چې د 'ح ر ث' د ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د ځمکې کرنې یا بزګرۍ معنی لري. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د ځمکې خاوند یا بزګر په توګه پندل شوی دی. دا نوم د سخت کار، لګښت او د ځمکې سره د تړاو نښه ده. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې په خپل کار کې سخت کار او لګښت لري.

in_english.name: Haritha
in_english.meaning: Haritha means a landowner, farmer, or one who plows the land
in_english.long_meaning: Haritha is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ح ر ث' (haratha), which means to plow or cultivate the land. In Islamic tradition, Haritha is associated with someone who works hard on the land, symbolizing diligence, fertility, and productivity. The name has historical significance, as it was borne by notable figures in early Islamic history, including a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. Haritha represents a person who is industrious, connected to the earth, and committed to their work, embodying values of hard work and responsibility.

data.cultural_impact: The name Haritha holds a unique charm in Islamic culture as it is associated with the early Muslim willing to embrace Islam. Haritha ibn Kalada, one of the earliest Muslims, is known for his profound love and acceptance of Prophet Muhammad SAW (peace be upon him) and his message, at a time when accepting Islam could result in persecution and even death. This warrior prince of the Lakhmids of Hira embraced Islam in secret, and his quiet yet unwavering faith serves as an inspiration and reminder of the courage and fortitude required to stay true to one's beliefs amidst adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the name Haritha carries profound meaning as it relates to growth and renewal. The Arabic root h-r-th signifies growth or flourishing. The name is a reminder that every individual goes through a journey of constant growth – nourishing the soul through Islamic practices, striving for personal development, and seeking knowledge and enlightenment. Furthermore, the spiritual significance can be related to the story of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) AS, who emerged from the belly of the whale, renewed and filled with faith. Just as Haritha ibn Kalada embraced Islam and growth, individuals can also use this name as a reminder to always seek renewal and rejuvenation in their spiritual lives.
